name: index-meta-workers
description: Workers/Edge-compatible subset of index-meta. No Node.js-specific dependencies.

scripts.test: tsup && node -e "const f=require('fs').readFileSync('dist/index.js','utf8');const bad=['node:fs','node:path','node:module','node:sqlite','better-sqlite3','bun:sqlite'];const found=bad.filter(b=>f.includes(b));if(found.length){console.error('Node.js leak:',found);process.exit(1)}else console.log('OK: no Node.js leak')"
